savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14099 in full (secs. 1-4): sec. 2 revoked EO 14042 (federal contractor COVID-19 safety protocols) and EO 14043 (federal employee COVID-19 vaccination) and said agency policies premised on them 'no longer may be enforced and shall be rescinded', effective 12:01 a.m. EDT on 2023-05-12 (sec. 3). Those revocations are completed acts on other orders. EO 14148 sec. 2(fff) revokes EO 14099 without revival wording, and revoking a revoking order does not by itself revive the orders it revoked, so EO 14042 and EO 14043 stay revoked: an effect of EO 14099 survives it (accrued). It transferred no function, fund or property and created no right (sec. 4(c)). S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) OVERRULED to transferred_or_accrued because of the completed revocations. Bounded search: every held official FR text (jobs/fr-originals, EO 1 through EO 14435) was grepped for the order's number and read where it appeared; OFR catalog edges (jobs/later-events EDGES.csv), the dossier's current-law leads (none) and the three machine searches were read.

research_rationale: EO 14099 (signed 2023-05-09, 88 FR 30891-30892), read in full from the held official FR text (sha256 verified), revokes EO 14042 and EO 14043 (sec. 2), is effective 12:01 a.m. EDT 2023-05-12 (sec. 3) and has the standard general provisions (sec. 4). It has no term or sunset. EO 14148 sec. 2(fff) (read in full, reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes it by number and title with no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, 2025-01-20. The dossier's single clause covered only the first 374 characters of sec. 1, so the inventory was corrected to six clauses covering secs. 1 through 4(c). No amending order exists: only EO 14099 itself and EO 14148 name EO 14099 among the held official texts (EO 11187 contains the number inside an unrelated list), the OFR catalog edges show only the 14148 revocation as acting on this order, and current-law leads are empty. Earlier-end test: sec. 2 revoked two orders at the order's effective moment, but the sec. 2 direction to rescind implementing policies and the order's standing sections have no completion date, and no source shows completion; the first end is therefore the 14148 revocation. Savings: completed revocations accrue (see savings reason).
